title: Ryan Packard pitches AppLovin at Sohn 2026
description: Hiddenite Capital Partners managing partner and CIO Ryan Packard sees AppLovin on track to becoming a $1 trillion company in seven years or less in his pitch for Adept Advantaged Allocators (AAA) at the Sohn Investment Conference 2026.
summary: The pitch argues that AppLovin is positioned to achieve a trillion-dollar market cap within seven years. The speaker specifically believes the stock will double in price over the next three years as part of this growth trajectory.
thesis: The pitch argues that AppLovin is positioned to achieve a trillion-dollar market cap within seven years. The speaker specifically believes the stock will double in price over the next three years as part of this growth trajectory.

claims.claim: The speaker believes AppLovin will double in stock price over the next three years and eventually become a trillion-dollar company.
claims.quote: If they do that, we think the stock will double over the next 3 years. 2030 GAAP EPS of $50 * 20 * earnings is $1,000 or a little bit more than a 100% upside from where it is currently trading.
claims.speaker: Ryan Packard

claims.claim: The presenter projects AppLovin will reach a trillion-dollar market cap within seven years based on its growth trajectory.
claims.quote: And we believe that AppLovin is on a similar trajectory to be valued at a trillion dollars in market cap in the next 7 years or less.
claims.speaker: Ryan Packard

numbers.quote: AppLovin is a $150 billion market cap company
In 2025, AppLovin generated approximately $5.5 billion of dollars of revenue
and nearly $4 billion in free cash flow
all the while maintaining a greater than 25% pre-tax ROIC
AppLovin will grow from $500 million revenue in 2021
to $10 billion in run rate revenue in the next 12 months
